[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended coffee shops near SoMa:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. **Four Barrel Coffee** (15-minute walk): A San Francisco staple with a location on 4th Street and Brannan, known for high-quality beans and a variety of pour-overs and espresso drinks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. **Blue Bottle Coffee** (12-minute walk): Located on New Montgomery Street, known for a minimalist atmosphere and expertly crafted pour-overs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. **Sightglass Coffee** (18-minute walk): Located on 7th Street and Folsom, offers a variety of blends and single-origin pour-overs, along with pastries and breakfast sandwiches.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. **Ritual Coffee Roasters** (15-minute walk): Located on the corner of 4th Street and Howard, serves delicious pour-overs, espresso drinks, and pastries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. **La Colombe Coffee** (12-minute walk): Located on 2nd Street and Folsom, offers a variety of blends, single-origin pour-overs, teas, and pastries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. **Verve Coffee Roasters** (18-minute walk): Located on 10th Street and Market, known for high-quality beans and a variety of pour-overs, espresso drinks, and pastries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] All recommended spots are within a 20-minute walk from SoMa.  
[USER] User decided to try out Four Barrel Coffee.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Four Barrel Coffee has a spacious and quiet area for work, divided into a bustling area near the counter and a more secluded area in the back with tables and comfortable seating.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The back area has plenty of natural light and is usually less crowded than the front section.
